answer: Because the title was issued by Texas, Texas's duplicate title rules apply, not Georgia's. We can't buy a paid-off car without a title, so you'll need a duplicate from Texas first, but you can still get an offer and book an appointment while you wait. The help center doesn't say how long a Texas duplicate takes (Georgia's 2-to-3-week timeline doesn't apply to your car), so please contact a store for that.

facts.fact: the duplicate rules of the state that issued the title (Texas) apply
Texas titles are electronic, so for the sale you usually don't need a printed duplicate
a printed Texas duplicate takes 5 to 7 business days online
